metadata.description: Kit ARTEX Blue Team pour Microsoft Sentinel. Fichier genere par sentinel/build_arm.py : ne pas modifier a la main.
Nom de l'espace de travail Log Analytics ou Microsoft Sentinel est active.
Activer les regles d'analyse des leur creation.
Creer un incident pour chaque alerte (sinon : alertes seules).

properties.query:
// ArtexWebRequests : vue unifiee des requetes HTTP, quelle que soit la source de logs.
// Utilisee par toutes les regles ARTEX. A enregistrer comme fonction (alias ArtexWebRequests).
// Chaque source absente de votre espace de travail est ignoree (union isfuzzy=true).
// Pour ajouter une source (table personnalisee nginx_CL, etc.), ajoutez une branche qui produit
// les memes colonnes que la datatable ci-dessous.
union isfuzzy=true
    // Schema de reference : garantit que la fonction marche meme sans aucune source.
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, SrcIp:string, Method:string, Host:string, UrlPath:string,
               UrlQuery:string, UserAgent:string, Status:int, Computer:string, LogSource:string)[]),
    // IIS (agent AMA / MMA)
    (W3CIISLog
    | project TimeGenerated,
        SrcIp = cIP,
        Method = csMethod,
        Host = tostring(column_ifexists("csHost", "")),
        UrlPath = csUriStem,
        UrlQuery = iff(csUriQuery == "-", "", csUriQuery),
        UserAgent = replace_string(csUserAgent, "+", " "),
        Status = toint(scStatus),
        Computer,
        LogSource = "IIS"),
    // Application Gateway / WAF v2 (mode AzureDiagnostics)
    (AzureDiagnostics
    | where Category == "ApplicationGatewayAccessLog"
    | extend _uri = tostring(column_ifexists("requestUri_s", ""))
    | project TimeGenerated,
        SrcIp = tostring(column_ifexists("clientIP_s", "")),
        Method = tostring(column_ifexists("httpMethod_s", "")),
        Host = tostring(column_ifexists("host_s", "")),
        UrlPath = tostring(split(_uri, "?")[0]),
        UrlQuery = extract(@"\?(.*)$", 1, _uri),
        UserAgent = tostring(column_ifexists("userAgent_s", "")),
        Status = toint(column_ifexists("httpStatus_d", real(null))),
        Computer = Resource,
        LogSource = "AppGateway"),
    // Application Gateway (tables specifiques a la ressource)
    (AGWAccessLogs
    | project TimeGenerated,
        SrcIp = ClientIp,
        Method = HttpMethod,
        Host,
        UrlPath = tostring(split(RequestUri, "?")[0]),
        UrlQuery = coalesce(RequestQuery, extract(@"\?(.*)$", 1, RequestUri)),
        UserAgent,
        Status = toint(HttpStatus),
        Computer = _ResourceId,
        LogSource = "AppGateway"),
    // Azure Front Door (classique / Standard / Premium, mode AzureDiagnostics)
    (AzureDiagnostics
    | where Category in ("FrontDoorAccessLog", "FrontdoorAccessLog")
    | extend _uri = tostring(column_ifexists("requestUri_s", ""))
    | project TimeGenerated,
        SrcIp = tostring(column_ifexists("clientIp_s", "")),
        Method = tostring(column_ifexists("httpMethod_s", "")),
        Host = extract(@"^https?://([^/:]+)", 1, _uri),
        UrlPath = extract(@"^(?:https?://[^/]+)?([^?]*)", 1, _uri),
        UrlQuery = extract(@"\?(.*)$", 1, _uri),
        UserAgent = tostring(column_ifexists("userAgent_s", "")),
        Status = toint(column_ifexists("httpStatusCode_s", "")),
        Computer = Resource,
        LogSource = "FrontDoor"),
    // Pare-feu / WAF / proxy tiers en CEF (Fortinet, Palo Alto, F5, Imperva, Barracuda, Zscaler...)
    (CommonSecurityLog
    | where isnotempty(RequestURL)
    | project TimeGenerated,
        SrcIp = SourceIP,
        Method = RequestMethod,
        Host = coalesce(DestinationHostName, extract(@"^https?://([^/:]+)", 1, RequestURL)),
        UrlPath = extract(@"^(?:https?://[^/]+)?([^?]*)", 1, RequestURL),
        UrlQuery = extract(@"\?(.*)$", 1, RequestURL),
        UserAgent = RequestClientApplication,
        Status = toint(extract(@"(?i)(?:^|;)\s*(?:status|httpStatus|responseCode)=(\d{3})", 1, AdditionalExtensions)),
        Computer,
        LogSource = strcat("CEF:", DeviceVendor, " ", DeviceProduct)),
    // Nginx / Apache envoyes en Syslog (format "combined")
    (Syslog
    | where ProcessName in~ ("nginx", "httpd", "apache", "apache2", "apache-access", "nginx-access")
    | extend _m = extract_all(@"^(\S+) \S+ \S+ \[[^\]]+\] ""(\S+) (\S+)[^""]*"" (\d{3}) \S+ ""[^""]*"" ""([^""]*)""", SyslogMessage)
    | where array_length(_m) > 0
    | extend _uri = tostring(_m[0][2])
    | project TimeGenerated,
        SrcIp = tostring(_m[0][0]),
        Method = tostring(_m[0][1]),
        Host = HostName,
        UrlPath = tostring(split(_uri, "?")[0]),
        UrlQuery = extract(@"\?(.*)$", 1, _uri),
        UserAgent = tostring(_m[0][4]),
        Status = toint(_m[0][3]),
        Computer,
        LogSource = "Syslog")
| extend Url = iff(isempty(UrlQuery), UrlPath, strcat(UrlPath, "?", UrlQuery))
// Target = URL brute + URL decodee : les regles cherchent les charges dans les deux formes
| extend Target = strcat(Url, " ", url_decode(Url))

properties.description:
Requete HTTP portant l'identifiant optionnel ARTEX-Assessment/1.0 (engagement=...), ajoute par ARTEX
quand l'identification d'evaluation est activee. Verifier la reference engagement= aupres de l'equipe
offensive : si le test n'est pas annonce, traiter comme une attaque.
Equivalent Sigma : rules/sigma/artex_assessment_user_agent.yml. Suricata : SID 9100001.
properties.query:
ArtexWebRequests
| where UserAgent startswith "ARTEX-Assessment/"
| where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist)
| extend Engagement = extract(@"engagement=([^)\s;]+)", 1, UserAgent)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Requests = count(),
    Hosts = make_set(Host, 20), SampleUrls = make_set(Url, 10), LogSources = make_set(LogSource, 5)
    by SrcIp, UserAgent, Engagement

properties.displayName: ARTEX - User-Agents des outils embarques (sqlmap, ffuf, nmap NSE, hydra, nuclei, dalfox, headless)
properties.description:
User-Agents par defaut des scanners livres dans l'image Docker d'ARTEX. Un seul n'est pas une preuve
d'ARTEX (ces outils sont courants), mais plusieurs outils depuis la meme IP en une heure est typique
de son orchestration. Ajouter vos scanners autorises dans la watchlist ArtexAllowlist.
Equivalent Sigma : rules/sigma/artex_toolchain_user_agents.yml. Suricata : SID 9100020-9100025.
properties.query:
ArtexWebRequests
| where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist)
| extend Tool = case(
    UserAgent contains "sqlmap/", "sqlmap",
    UserAgent contains "Fuzz Faster U Fool", "ffuf",
    UserAgent contains "Nmap Scripting Engine", "nmap NSE",
    UserAgent contains "(Hydra)", "hydra",
    UserAgent contains "nuclei", "nuclei",
    UserAgent contains "dalfox", "dalfox",
    UserAgent contains "HeadlessChrome", "Chromium headless (Playwright)",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Tool)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Requests = count(),
    Tools = make_set(Tool), UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent, 10), Hosts = make_set(Host, 20)
    by SrcIp
| extend ToolCount = array_length(Tools)
| order by ToolCount desc, Requests desc

properties.displayName: ARTEX - Tentative de LFI ou de traversee de repertoire
properties.description:
Charges LFI classiques testees par les workers ARTEX (nuclei, ffuf, tests du planner) avant la chaine
php2shell. Un code HTTP 200 sur ces requetes merite une verification immediate du serveur.
Equivalent Sigma : rules/sigma/artex_lfi_traversal.yml. Suricata : SID 9100050.
properties.query:
ArtexWebRequests
| where Target matches regex @"(?i)(\.\./){3,}|(%2e%2e(%2f|/)){3,}|(\.\.%2f){2,}|/etc/passwd|php://(filter|input)|data://text/plain|expect://"
| where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Attempts = count(),
    Http200 = countif(Status == 200), SampleUrls = make_set(Url, 10), Hosts = make_set(Host, 20),
    UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent, 5)
    by SrcIp

properties.displayName: ARTEX php2shell - Inclusion d'un fichier de session PHP via LFI
properties.description:
Etape finale de la chaine php2shell d'ARTEX : un parametre d'inclusion pointe vers un fichier sess_*
rempli au prealable via PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS, ce qui execute du code sur le serveur.
Un code HTTP 200 indique une compromission probable (P1 du playbook) : isoler et collecter les preuves.
Equivalent Sigma : rules/sigma/artex_php2shell_session_lfi.yml. Suricata : SID 9100040-9100042.
properties.query:
ArtexWebRequests
| where Target contains "sess_"
| where Target matches regex @"(?i)sess_[a-z0-9,-]{6,}"
| where Target matches regex @"(?i)(\.\./|%2e%2e|/tmp/|/var/lib/php)"
| where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Attempts = count(),
    Http200 = countif(Status == 200), Statuses = make_set(Status), SampleUrls = make_set(Url, 10)
    by SrcIp, Host, Computer
| extend Verdict = iff(Http200 > 0, "Compromission probable (HTTP 200)", "Tentative")

properties.displayName: ARTEX - Sondes SQLi et XSS automatisees (sqlmap, dalfox, nuclei)
properties.description:
Rafale de charges SQLi/XSS generees par les outils d'ARTEX. Seuil : 3 requetes suspectes par IP
sur l'heure (ajustable via la variable seuil).
Equivalent Sigma : rules/sigma/artex_sqli_xss_probes.yml.
properties.query:
let seuil = 3;
let sqli = @"(?i)union(\s|\+|/\*\*/)+(all(\s|\+)+)?select|sleep\(\s*\d+\s*\)|waitfor(\s|\+)+delay|(\s|\+)and(\s|\+)+1=1|extractvalue\(|updatexml\(|'(\s|\+)*or(\s|\+)*'?1'?(\s|\+)*=(\s|\+)*'?1";
let xss = @"(?i)<script|onerror(\s|\+)*=|onload(\s|\+)*=(\s|\+)*alert|javascript:alert|<svg";
ArtexWebRequests
| where isnotempty(UrlQuery)
| extend IsSqli = Target matches regex sqli, IsXss = Target matches regex xss
| where IsSqli or IsXss
| where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Probes = count(),
    SqliProbes = countif(IsSqli), XssProbes = countif(IsXss), Http500 = countif(Status >= 500),
    SampleUrls = make_set(Url, 10), Hosts = make_set(Host, 20), UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent, 5)
    by SrcIp
| where Probes >= seuil

properties.displayName: ARTEX - Rafale de requetes ou enumeration massive (ffuf, katana, nuclei)
properties.description:
ARTEX tourne par defaut sans limitation de debit (profil de bruit "off") : rafales de requetes et
centaines de 404 en quelques minutes pendant l'enumeration. Detecte, par tranche de 5 minutes, une IP
qui depasse 500 requetes, ou 100 reponses 404 sur au moins 100 chemins differents.
Le profil "quiet" (~2 req/s) est couvert par la requete de chasse artex_slow_scan.kql.
Suricata : SID 9100060.
properties.query:
let seuilRequetes = 500;
let seuil404 = 100;
ArtexWebRequests
| where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist)
| summarize Requests = count(), NotFound = countif(Status == 404), DistinctPaths = dcount(UrlPath),
    UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent, 5), Hosts = make_set(Host, 10)
    by SrcIp, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where Requests >= seuilRequetes or (NotFound >= seuil404 and DistinctPaths >= seuil404)
| summarize StartTime = min(Window), EndTime = max(Window) + 5m, PeakRequestsPer5m = max(Requests),
    Total404 = sum(NotFound), MaxDistinctPaths = max(DistinctPaths),
    SampleUserAgents = take_any(UserAgents), SampleHosts = take_any(Hosts)
    by SrcIp

properties.displayName: ARTEX - Score d'attaque par IP (equivalent de artex_triage.py)
properties.description:
Reprend le score de tools/artex_triage.py : chaque signature (UA d'outil, charge LFI/SQLi/XSS,
php2shell, OAST, injection de commande) compte une fois par IP avec son poids, plus des bonus
comportementaux (rafale, 404 massifs, rotation de User-Agents). Alerte a partir de 100 (CRITIQUE),
ce qui correspond a une chaine reconnaissance + exploitation typique d'ARTEX.
Fenetre : 6 heures, evaluee toutes les heures.
properties.query:
let seuilScore = 100;
let web = ArtexWebRequests
  | where isnotempty(SrcIp)
  | where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist);
// Chaque signature vaut 1 si l'IP l'a touchee au moins une fois (poids compte une seule fois)
let hits = web
  | extend
      ua_artex = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)^ARTEX-Assessment/",
      ua_sqlmap = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)sqlmap/",
      ua_ffuf = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)Fuzz Faster U Fool",
      ua_nmap = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)Nmap Scripting Engine",
      ua_hydra = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)\(Hydra\)",
      ua_headless = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)HeadlessChrome",
      ua_nuclei = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)nuclei",
      ua_dalfox = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)dalfox",
      ua_pd = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)katana|httpx|projectdiscovery",
      ua_bbot = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)bbot",
      ua_script = UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)python-requests|python-urllib|aiohttp|Go-http-client|curl/|Wget/",
      p_sess = Target matches regex @"(?i)sess_[a-z0-9,-]{6,}",
      p_upload = Target matches regex @"(?i)PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS",
      p_lfi = Target matches regex @"(?i)(\.\./){3,}|/etc/passwd|php://(filter|input)|data://text/plain|expect://",
      p_sqli = Target matches regex @"(?i)union(\s|\+)+all(\s|\+)+select|sleep\(\d+\)|waitfor(\s|\+)+delay|extractvalue\(|updatexml\(|'(\s|\+)*or(\s|\+)*'?1'?(\s|\+)*=(\s|\+)*'?1",
      p_xss = Target matches regex @"(?i)<script|onerror\s*=|onload\s*=|javascript:alert|<svg",
      p_oast = Target matches regex @"(?i)\.oast\.(pro|live|site|online|fun|me)|interact\.sh",
      p_tpl = Target matches regex @"(?i)\$\{jndi:|\{\{\d+\*\d+\}\}|\$\{\d+\*\d+\}",
      p_cmd = Target matches regex @"(?i);\s*(id|whoami|uname)\b|\|\s*(id|whoami)\b|`id`|\$\(id\)"
  | summarize
      ua_artex = max(toint(ua_artex)), ua_sqlmap = max(toint(ua_sqlmap)), ua_ffuf = max(toint(ua_ffuf)),
      ua_nmap = max(toint(ua_nmap)), ua_hydra = max(toint(ua_hydra)), ua_headless = max(toint(ua_headless)),
      ua_nuclei = max(toint(ua_nuclei)), ua_dalfox = max(toint(ua_dalfox)), ua_pd = max(toint(ua_pd)),
      ua_bbot = max(toint(ua_bbot)), ua_script = max(toint(ua_script)),
      p_sess = max(toint(p_sess)), p_upload = max(toint(p_upload)), p_lfi = max(toint(p_lfi)),
      p_sqli = max(toint(p_sqli)), p_xss = max(toint(p_xss)), p_oast = max(toint(p_oast)),
      p_tpl = max(toint(p_tpl)), p_cmd = max(toint(p_cmd)),
      Requests = count(), Errors4xx = countif(Status between (400 .. 499)),
      DistinctPaths = dcount(UrlPath), DistinctUA = dcount(UserAgent),
      StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Hosts = make_set(Host, 20)
      by SrcIp;
let peaks = web
  | summarize c = count() by SrcIp, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
  | summarize PeakRequestsPer5m = max(c) by SrcIp;
hits
| join kind=leftouter peaks on SrcIp
| extend SignatureScore =
      100 * ua_artex + 60 * ua_sqlmap + 50 * ua_ffuf + 40 * ua_nmap + 60 * ua_hydra + 20 * ua_headless
    + 50 * ua_nuclei + 50 * ua_dalfox + 40 * ua_pd + 40 * ua_bbot + 10 * ua_script
    + 80 * p_sess + 60 * p_upload + 40 * p_lfi + 40 * p_sqli + 20 * p_xss + 50 * p_oast
    + 30 * p_tpl + 40 * p_cmd
| extend BonusBurst = iff(PeakRequestsPer5m >= 500, 30, 0),
    BonusEnum = iff(DistinctPaths >= 200 and todouble(Errors4xx) / Requests > 0.6, 30, 0),
    BonusUA = iff(DistinctUA >= 5, 20, 0)
| extend Score = SignatureScore + BonusBurst + BonusEnum + BonusUA
| where Score >= seuilScore
| extend Signatures = bag_pack(
      "ARTEX-Assessment", ua_artex, "sqlmap", ua_sqlmap, "ffuf", ua_ffuf, "nmap", ua_nmap,
      "hydra", ua_hydra, "headless", ua_headless, "nuclei", ua_nuclei, "dalfox", ua_dalfox,
      "projectdiscovery", ua_pd, "bbot", ua_bbot, "script", ua_script,
      "php2shell_sess", p_sess, "upload_progress", p_upload, "lfi", p_lfi, "sqli", p_sqli,
      "xss", p_xss, "oast", p_oast, "template_jndi", p_tpl, "cmd_injection", p_cmd,
      "rafale", BonusBurst / 30, "enumeration", BonusEnum / 30, "rotation_ua", BonusUA / 20)
| mv-apply s = Signatures on (where toint(s[tostring(bag_keys(s)[0])]) == 1
    | summarize SignatureList = make_list(tostring(bag_keys(s)[0])))
| extend Level = case(Score >= 100, "CRITIQUE", Score >= 60, "ELEVE", Score >= 30, "MOYEN", "FAIBLE")
| project SrcIp, Score, Level, Signatures = strcat_array(SignatureList, ", "), Requests, Errors4xx,
    DistinctPaths, DistinctUA, PeakRequestsPer5m, StartTime, EndTime, Hosts
| order by Score desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Signatures : {{Signatures}}. Voir le playbook ARTEX, section 2 (qualification).

properties.displayName: ARTEX - Instance ARTEX lancee sur un hote interne
properties.description:
Demarrage du serveur ARTEX ou de son conteneur (binaire artex, image ghcr.io/baarai/artex,
variables ARTEX_*). Legitime seulement pour l'equipe offensive autorisee ; sinon quelqu'un heberge
une plateforme de pentest autonome chez vous (playbook, section 4).
Sources : Defender for Endpoint (DeviceProcessEvents), evenements Windows 4688 (SecurityEvent),
Syslog/auditd. Equivalent Sigma : rules/sigma/artex_instance_on_host.yml.
properties.query:
let marqueurs = @"(?i)ghcr\.io/baarai/artex|baarai/artex|ARTEX_NOISE_PROFILE|ARTEX_PG_HOST|ARTEX_BIND_ADDR";
union isfuzzy=true
  (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, HostName:string, AccountName:string, Image:string, CommandLine:string, LogSource:string)[]),
  (DeviceProcessEvents
  | where FolderPath contains "artex" or ProcessCommandLine contains "artex"
  | where FolderPath endswith "/artex" or ProcessCommandLine matches regex marqueurs
  | project TimeGenerated, HostName = DeviceName, AccountName, Image = FolderPath,
      CommandLine = ProcessCommandLine, LogSource = "MDE"),
  (SecurityEvent
  | where EventID == 4688
  | where NewProcessName contains "artex" or CommandLine contains "artex"
  | where NewProcessName endswith @"\artex.exe" or CommandLine matches regex marqueurs
  | project TimeGenerated, HostName = Computer, AccountName = SubjectUserName, Image = NewProcessName,
      CommandLine, LogSource = "SecurityEvent 4688"),
  (Syslog
  | where SyslogMessage contains "artex"
  | where SyslogMessage matches regex marqueurs or SyslogMessage matches regex @"exe=""?[^ ""]*/artex""?(\s|$)"
  | project TimeGenerated, HostName = Computer, AccountName = "", Image = ProcessName,
      CommandLine = SyslogMessage, LogSource = "Syslog")
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count(),
    CommandLines = make_set(CommandLine, 10), Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 10)
    by HostName, LogSource

properties.displayName: ARTEX - Callback OAST (interactsh) depuis un serveur interne
properties.description:
nuclei, utilise par ARTEX, confirme les vulnerabilites aveugles (SSRF, RCE, XXE, Log4Shell) en
faisant contacter par la cible un domaine *.oast.* ou *.interact.sh. Une resolution de ces domaines
par un de vos serveurs signifie qu'une charge a ete executee ou interpretee : vulnerabilite confirmee.
Sources : DnsEvents (DNS Windows), DeviceNetworkEvents (Defender), ASimDnsActivityLogs.
Suricata : SID 9100030-9100031.
properties.query:
let oast = @"(?i)(^|\.)(oast\.(pro|live|site|online|fun|me)|interact\.sh)\.?$";
union isfuzzy=true
  (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, ClientIp:string, HostName:string, Domain:string, LogSource:string)[]),
  (DnsEvents
  | where Name contains "oast." or Name contains "interact.sh"
  | where Name matches regex oast
  | project TimeGenerated, ClientIp = ClientIP, HostName = Computer, Domain = Name, LogSource = "DnsEvents"),
  (DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where RemoteUrl contains "oast." or RemoteUrl contains "interact.sh"
  | extend Domain = tostring(split(trim_end("/", tostring(split(replace_regex(RemoteUrl, @"^[a-z]+://", ""), "/")[0])), ":")[0])
  | where Domain matches regex oast
  | project TimeGenerated, ClientIp = LocalIP, HostName = DeviceName, Domain, LogSource = "MDE"),
  (ASimDnsActivityLogs
  | where DnsQuery contains "oast." or DnsQuery contains "interact.sh"
  | where DnsQuery matches regex oast
  | project TimeGenerated, ClientIp = SrcIpAddr, HostName = Dvc, Domain = DnsQuery, LogSource = "ASimDns")
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Lookups = count(),
    Domains = make_set(Domain, 20)
    by ClientIp, HostName, LogSource

properties.displayName: ARTEX - Alertes Suricata du kit ARTEX (SID 9100001-9100099)
properties.description:
Remonte dans Sentinel les alertes des regles rules/suricata/artex.rules, envoyees en Syslog
(fast.log / sortie syslog de Suricata) ou en CEF. Couvre ce que les logs web ne voient pas :
en-tetes X-ARTEX-*, corps multipart PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS, acces aux ports 8787/8788.
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true
  (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, Sid:int, Msg:string, SrcIp:string, DstIp:string, Sensor:string)[]),
  (Syslog
  | where SyslogMessage contains "[1:910"
  | extend Sid = toint(extract(@"\[1:(910\d{4}):\d+\]", 1, SyslogMessage))
  | where Sid between (9100001 .. 9100099)
  | project TimeGenerated, Sid,
      Msg = trim(@"\s", extract(@"\[1:910\d{4}:\d+\]\s*(.*?)\s*\[(Classification|\*\*)", 1, SyslogMessage)),
      SrcIp = extract(@"\}\s*([0-9a-fA-F:.]+?)(?::\d+)?\s*->", 1, SyslogMessage),
      DstIp = extract(@"->\s*([0-9a-fA-F:.]+?)(?::\d+)?\s*$", 1, SyslogMessage),
      Sensor = Computer),
  (CommonSecurityLog
  | where DeviceProduct has "Suricata" or DeviceVendor has "OISF"
  | extend Sid = toint(extract(@"(910\d{4})", 1, DeviceEventClassID))
  | where Sid between (9100001 .. 9100099)
  | project TimeGenerated, Sid, Msg = Activity, SrcIp = SourceIP, DstIp = DestinationIP, Sensor = Computer)
| where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Hits = count(),
    Sids = make_set(Sid), Messages = make_set(Msg, 10), Targets = make_set(DstIp, 20)
    by SrcIp, Sensor
| extend SidCount = array_length(Sids)

properties.displayName: ARTEX - Verification de mise a jour d'une instance ARTEX interne
properties.description:
Une instance ARTEX verifie ses mises a jour avec le User-Agent "artex-update-check". Vu dans les
logs du proxy ou du pare-feu sortant (CEF), il revele une instance ARTEX dans votre reseau.
Suricata : SID 9100002.
properties.query:
ArtexWebRequests
| where UserAgent =~ "artex-update-check"
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Requests = count(),
    Destinations = make_set(Host, 10), LogSources = make_set(LogSource, 5)
    by SrcIp

properties.displayName: ARTEX - Service a l'ecoute sur 8787 (UI/API) ou 8788 (proxy MITM)
properties.query:
// Titre : ARTEX - Service a l'ecoute sur 8787 (UI/API) ou 8788 (proxy MITM)
// Tactique : ResourceDevelopment (T1588)
// Ports par defaut d'une instance ARTEX. A croiser avec la regle "Instance ARTEX lancee sur un hote".
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where (ActionType == "ListeningConnectionCreated" and LocalPort in (8787, 8788))
        or (ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "InboundConnectionAccepted") and RemotePort in (8787, 8788))
    | project TimeGenerated, HostName = DeviceName, ActionType, LocalIP, LocalPort, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
        Process = InitiatingProcessFileName, CommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
    (CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)

    | project TimeGenerated, HostName = DestinationHostName, ActionType = DeviceAction, LocalIP = DestinationIP,
        LocalPort = DestinationPort, RemoteIP = SourceIP, RemotePort = SourcePort, Process = "", CommandLine = "")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count(),

    by HostName, LocalIP, LocalPort
| order by Events desc

properties.query:
// Titre : ARTEX - Charges d'exploitation ayant recu une reponse 200/500
// Tactique : InitialAccess (T1190)
// Pour la qualification P2/P1 du playbook : quelles charges ont abouti, sur quels hotes ?
let periode = 7d;
ArtexWebRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(periode)
| extend Category = case(
    Target matches regex @"(?i)sess_[a-z0-9,-]{6,}", "php2shell",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)(\.\./){3,}|/etc/passwd|php://(filter|input)|data://text/plain|expect://", "LFI",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)union(\s|\+)+(all(\s|\+)+)?select|sleep\(\d+\)|waitfor(\s|\+)+delay|extractvalue\(|updatexml\(", "SQLi",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)<script|onerror\s*=|javascript:alert|<svg", "XSS",
    Target matches regex @"(?i);\s*(id|whoami|uname)\b|\|\s*(id|whoami)\b|\$\(id\)", "Injection de commande",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Category)
| where Status == 200 or Status >= 500
| summarize Hits = count(), Statuses = make_set(Status), SampleUrls = make_set(Url, 5),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by SrcIp, Host, Category
| order by Category asc, Hits desc
